question: B-02: Fresh verification of the account owner for sensitive settings. Why this fork must be decided: S1 only decided that the person must be verified and must not be locked out, and did not decide a fresh-verification protocol. Do not add a password or recovery code back to routine passwordless login. Do not confuse an account name plus a code with two independent factors.

options.A: The current password plus an unused TOTP is exchanged for a 5-minute, single-purpose, one-time ActionGrant bound to the current device (routine passwordless login still requires no password). This creates password friction for sensitive operations; a forgotten password uses independent recovery.
options.B: A currently valid device plus a fresh TOTP issues the same kind of grant; only password changes additionally require the current password. This is smoother, but the settings-takeover surface is larger after the single TOTP factor is stolen.
